narrative.overview: CUBO treats each screen like a composed vehicle cabin: the one state a driver needs now is dominant, while secondary controls remain calm, predictable, and close to the hand. The system is premium through restraint rather than ornament.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant state or action per viewport.
Cool mineral light surfaces and deep forest dark surfaces.
Restrained signal green and semantic alert colors.
Compact floating navigation and bottom-sheet map controls.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Green identifies action, selection, readiness, or monitoring; it does not fill every container.

rules.name: The Semantic Marker Rule
rules.body: Police and community warnings are orange, route urgency is red, the driver is blue or green, and routes remain CUBO green.

rules.name: The Glance Rule
rules.body: The important number or action must read before supporting copy; labels never compete with the primary state.

rules.name: The Float With Purpose Rule
rules.body: A shadow signals a surface that moves, overlays, or controls the page; ordinary rows use tone and spacing instead.

dos: Do make the map, safety score, or immediate action dominate each screen.
Do use Signal Green sparingly for meaningful state and interaction.
Do preserve at least 44px touch targets and readable contrast in both modes.
Do keep motion interruptible and honor reduced-motion settings.
donts: Don't turn every section into an equal soft card.
Don't use neon green, blue-black default dark mode, gradient text, or decorative glass effects.
Don't copy another product's branding or signature assets.
Don't let visual polish imply capabilities CUBO does not have.
